_about: The tools Études ships. The docs sidebar and the docs index read this list; a new tool is one new entry.

tools.name: sweep
tools.description: Sorts a messy folder into groups, and moves nothing until you have seen the plan.

tools.name: stash
tools.description: Moves files out of the way without deleting them, and brings them back.

tools.name: unpack
tools.description: Opens an archive into one clean folder, or places nothing at all.
